top_creatures.label: Brood Sky Matron (own label)
top_creatures.why: A ground boss that lifts off at a health threshold and drops a capped swarm; the takeoff is a large silhouette change that reads at 375 wide.
top_creatures.keep: Threshold lift; capped swarm per phase; a second threshold that ends the air phase.
top_creatures.change: Our arena and names; a shorter-lived swarm; our own telegraphs.

top_creatures.label: Sweep Warden (own label)
top_creatures.why: The arena floor is the threat: a timed safe lane sweeps across sections on a timer, with a timed window.
top_creatures.keep: A telegraphed safe lane that moves on a timer; a timed window every 90 s.
top_creatures.change: Our tile shapes and telegraph colours; no teleport penalty (the TeleportCheaters body is not read).

top_creatures.label: Ice Wyrm Late Rise (own label)
top_creatures.why: A second behaviour switch at 35 percent health gives a late-fight change of pace.
top_creatures.change: Everything else; the body of the switch is not read.

top_creatures.label: Four-Element Brood (own label)
top_creatures.why: Four elemental families give four distinct silhouette and palette groups.
top_creatures.change: Our four elements, moves and sounds.
top_creatures.ref: src/server/game/Miscellaneous/SharedDefines.h lines 5083 (water 49), 5098 (fire 116), 145 storm, 117 earth (receipts TC-R06, TC-R07). Identity only; behaviour not read.

top_creatures.label: Hydra-Kin (own label)
top_creatures.why: A multi-head silhouette can be read at 375 wide.
top_creatures.change: Head count, colour and attack pattern.
top_creatures.ref: src/server/game/Miscellaneous/SharedDefines.h line 5091 (hydra 68). Identity only; behaviour not read.

top_creatures.label: Felguard Warband (own label)

top_creatures.keep: Group composition from one type mask.
top_creatures.ref: src/server/game/Miscellaneous/SharedDefines.h lines 5066 (felguard 29) and 5035 (demon-or-undead mask) (receipts TC-R08, TC-R03). Identity only.

top_creatures.label: Crypt Ghoul (own label)

looks.label: Floor-tile telegraph
looks.technique: Per-section game-object tiles; the erupt tick casts a trap spell on unsafe sections only (receipts TC-R25, TC-R41).

looks.label: Takeoff lift
looks.technique: Enable flight, then a move to a fixed hover point (TC-R18, TC-R40). Landing sequence not fully read.

looks.label: Quality ladder
looks.technique: Nine tiers in one enum (TC-R13, TC-R14). Visual mapping is in the client, not in the box.

looks.label: Siege state counts
looks.technique: Destroyed and damaged tower counts drive the objective (TC-R30). UpdateDamagedTowerCount is at line 1233 but not re-read.

looks.label: Spell visual tables
looks.technique: spell_visual, spell_visual_kit, spell_visual_missile, spell_visual_effect_name are in the hotfix schema. Row data not read; no glow or aura values taken.

originals.name: Brood Sky Matron
originals.idea: A ground boss lifts at 65 percent health, drops a capped swarm, and ends the air phase at 40 percent.
originals.keep: Threshold lift; capped swarm; second threshold.
originals.change: Our arena, names, and a shorter swarm.

originals.name: Sweep Warden
originals.idea: A timed safe lane moves across a four-section floor; unsafe sections erupt; a dance window every 90 s.
originals.keep: Moving safe lane and timed window.
originals.change: Ring-shaped tiles, a readable telegraph, no teleport penalty.

originals.name: Siege Towers zone
originals.idea: A timed siege where tower counts set the objective and the timer can end the battle.
originals.keep: Tower counts feed the objective; timer end.
originals.change: Our zone, factions, and end rules.

originals.name: Four-Element Brood
originals.idea: Four elemental groups, each with its own silhouette.

originals.name: Nine-step gear ladder
originals.idea: A stepped gear tier ladder with a heirloom step that scales with level.
originals.keep: Step count and the heirloom class.
originals.change: Our colours, glow and sounds per step.

originals.name: Capture-point zone
originals.idea: Capture points are the zone objective.
